name: Love Seed ~The Legacy of Empire~
source:
Distant future, another galaxy. There are five star systems each forming a nation. You are a freelance captain of a spaceship and can take missions varying from good transportation to pirates elimination and sometimes even revealing nation scale conspiracies. The whole universe is before you!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
遥远的未来，另一个星系。有五个星系，每个星系组成一个国家。你是一艘宇宙飞船的自由船长，可以执行各种任务，从良好的运输到消灭海盗，有时甚至揭露国家规模的阴谋。整个宇宙就在你面前！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
